title: 建设性对齐：人机交互中的偏好动态治理
summary: 提出“建设性对齐”范式，将AI对齐重新定义为对人类偏好演化轨迹的控制问题，而非静态偏好满足。基于行为经济学和建构主义理论，形式化建模偏好为随交互演化的状态变量，强调对齐应治理长期价值形成，而非仅控制AI行为。
summary_en: Introduces Constructive Alignment, a paradigm reframing AI alignment as controlling evolving human preference trajectories rather than static preference satisfaction. Formalizes preferences as layered state variables evolving under AI interaction, arguing alignment should govern long-term value formation.
